rules.statement: Keep routine work inside softPercent of the context window.
rules.reason: Past the soft band the agent loses earlier context and repeats work.
rules.remediation: Checkpoint {detail} and continue in a fresh session before {limit}%.

rules.statement: Stop and checkpoint at hardPercent of the context window.
rules.reason: Past the hard band output degrades and the run must continue fresh.
rules.remediation: Checkpoint now: the hard band is {limit}%.

rules.statement: Finish within maxToolCalls tool calls per session.
rules.reason: Unbounded tool loops burn context and hide stuck runs.
rules.remediation: Checkpoint and continue; the session limit is {limit} calls.

rules.statement: Never re-read a file whose content is already in context.
rules.reason: Re-reads waste context and tool calls.
rules.remediation: Reuse the copy of {path} already in context.

rules.statement: Consult the knowledge-graph output before broad scans, when present.
rules.reason: Scanning without the graph repeats indexed work.
rules.remediation: Query the knowledge graph for {path} before scanning.

rules.statement: Use only declared MCP servers.
rules.reason: Undeclared servers run unreviewed code with repo access.
rules.remediation: Declare the server in config or remove its use from {path}.

rules.statement: No credentials, tokens or private keys in the repo or context.
rules.reason: A credential in the repo or context cannot be revoked from history.
rules.remediation: Read it from an env var; add the name, without a value, to .env.example.

rules.statement: Never read secret material into the agent context.
rules.reason: Secrets in context leak into logs, events and model calls.
rules.remediation: Stop reading {path} and revoke the exposed value.

rules.statement: No unanalysed shell that escapes confinement.
rules.reason: Shell escapes bypass every other guard.
rules.remediation: Rewrite the command in {path} without the blocked construct.

rules.statement: Write only inside the repo root or the OS temp dir.
rules.reason: Writes outside the root escape review and ownership.
rules.remediation: Move the write target under the repo root: {path}.

rules.statement: Pin every dependency to an exact version.
rules.reason: Ranges resolve differently over time and break replay.
rules.remediation: Pin {value} to an exact version in {path}.

rules.statement: Commit the lockfile for every manifest.
rules.reason: Without a lockfile the install is not the reviewed one.

rules.statement: No dependency with a known advisory.
rules.reason: Known vulnerabilities ship known exploits.
rules.remediation: Upgrade {value} past the advisory, then re-run the sweep.

rules.statement: No deprecated dependency.
rules.reason: Deprecated packages stop receiving security fixes.

rules.statement: Stay within lagDays of latest stable.
rules.reason: Stale dependencies accumulate upgrade risk and advisories.
rules.remediation: Upgrade {value} to a release newer than {limit} days.

rules.statement: Every new dependency carries a reason.
rules.reason: Unexplained dependencies hide capability duplication.

rules.statement: One package per capability.
rules.reason: Two packages for one job double the audit surface.
rules.remediation: Remove {value}; the platform or the kept package already covers it.

rules.statement: Every dependency license is in the allow policy.
rules.reason: Unreviewed licenses create legal exposure.
rules.remediation: Replace {value} with an allowed-license package or tighten the policy.

rules.statement: Every test traces to a SPEC reference.
rules.reason: Untraced tests cannot prove the spec they guard.
rules.remediation: Give the test in {path} a literal SPEC reference.

rules.statement: Prove red before implementing.
rules.reason: A test that never failed proves nothing.
rules.remediation: Record the failing run for {path} before implementing.

rules.statement: Cover the scenario's required test kinds.
rules.reason: Wrong-kind tests miss the layer they should guard.

rules.statement: Every fix ships a regression test.
rules.reason: Fixes without regression tests regress.

rules.statement: Hold line and branch coverage at the floor.
rules.reason: Falling coverage hides untested behaviour.

rules.statement: No test edit removes an assertion.
rules.reason: Lost assertions silently weaken the suite.

rules.statement: No skipped or focused tests.
rules.reason: Skips hide failures and rot the suite.
rules.remediation: Unskip the test in {path} or delete it.

rules.statement: No new lint, type or coverage suppressions.
rules.reason: Suppressions move failures out of sight.
rules.remediation: Fix the finding in {path} instead of suppressing it.

rules.statement: No fixture edit that weakens a rule.
rules.reason: Shrunk fixtures let violations pass.

rules.statement: No lowered gate threshold.
rules.reason: Lowered thresholds ratify decay.

rules.statement: Run the repo's own test commands unmodified.
rules.reason: Rewritten commands skip the gates they should run.

rules.statement: Never raise a baseline entry.
rules.reason: Raised baselines bless worse code.
rules.remediation: Lower the count for {detail} instead of raising the baseline.

rules.statement: Source files stay under maxLines lines.
rules.reason: Oversize files resist review and hide coupling.

rules.statement: Functions stay under maxLines lines.
rules.reason: Long functions mix responsibilities and resist tests.

rules.statement: Cyclomatic complexity stays under maxCyclomatic.
rules.reason: Branchy code hides untested paths.

rules.statement: No duplicated token runs above minTokens.
rules.reason: Copies drift and fix in one place only.
rules.remediation: Extract the duplication at {path}:{line} into one helper.

rules.statement: No unused exports or members.
rules.reason: Dead code misleads readers and rots.

rules.statement: No interface or abstract type with one implementation.
rules.reason: Speculative abstractions tax every reader for no seam.

rules.statement: No deleted validation, throw or assert in a living function.
rules.reason: Removed guards reopen the failure they closed.

rules.statement: Touching a file lowers at least one ratchet metric.
rules.reason: Touched files must leave the tree better, never worse.
rules.remediation: Reduce a ratchet metric for {path} by {limit}.

rules.statement: Remediation steps stay within maxFiles files and maxChangedLines lines.
rules.reason: Oversize steps cannot be reviewed or safely landed.

rules.statement: Committed files stay under maxBytes bytes.
rules.reason: Huge files bloat clones and dodge review.
rules.remediation: Shrink {path} below {limit} bytes or stop tracking it.

rules.statement: The repo declares its architecture profile.
rules.reason: Without a profile no boundary can be checked.

rules.statement: Every source file maps to a declared module.
rules.reason: Unmapped files escape boundary checks.

rules.statement: No import crosses a denied boundary.
rules.reason: Boundary breaks recouple the modules.

rules.statement: Cross-module imports use public entries.
rules.reason: Deep imports freeze internals.
rules.remediation: Import the public entry instead of {path}:{line}.

rules.statement: No dependency cycles between modules.
rules.reason: Cycles merge modules and block layering.

rules.statement: Modules stay within maxFiles files and maxLines lines.
rules.reason: Oversize modules are monoliths by another name.

rules.statement: Strict compiler settings stay on.
rules.reason: Loose settings hide type errors the pack assumes absent.

rules.statement: Every commit carries a history entry.
rules.reason: Missing entries erase the reason a change was safe.

rules.statement: History files are append-only.
rules.reason: Edits rewrite the record reviewers trusted.
rules.remediation: Revert the edit to {path}; append a new entry instead.

rules.statement: History entries carry every required field.
rules.reason: Incomplete entries skip the review the kind requires.

rules.statement: Every defect has a bug row.
rules.reason: Unrecorded defects skip diagnosis and regression tests.

rules.statement: Bug rows never change after filing.
rules.reason: Edited rows rewrite the defect record.
rules.remediation: Revert the edit to {path}; append instead.

rules.statement: Diagnose before fixing.
rules.reason: Undiagnosed fixes treat symptoms.
rules.remediation: Record the diagnosis for {detail} before fixing.

rules.statement: Mandatory gates stay in order.
rules.reason: Skipped gates ship unreviewed work.

rules.statement: Write only files the plan allows.
rules.reason: Out-of-plan writes bypass task scoping.
rules.remediation: Stop writing {path}; extend the plan first.

rules.statement: Stop after maxRepeats failed attempts.
rules.reason: Endless retries burn context and repeat the same error.

rules.statement: Changes pass review before landing.
rules.reason: Unreviewed changes bypass the second pair of eyes.

rules.statement: Reviews close within maxRounds rounds.
rules.reason: Endless rounds mean the change is too big or unclear.

rules.statement: Docs live in owned locations.
rules.reason: Scattered docs rot and contradict.

rules.statement: Docs sit one level under their router.
rules.reason: Deep trees hide docs from their owners.

rules.statement: Every doc folder has its router leaf.
rules.reason: Routerless folders have no stated owner.

rules.statement: Docs stay within maxBytes bytes and maxLines lines.
rules.reason: Oversize docs are not read.

rules.statement: Doc folders stay within maxH2 headings and maxFilesPerFolder files.
rules.reason: Wide folders bury their subject.

rules.statement: Sentences and paragraphs stay short.
rules.reason: Dense prose is not reviewed.

rules.statement: Doc links resolve.
rules.reason: Broken links strand readers.

rules.statement: No inline changelogs in docs.
rules.reason: Inline history duplicates HISTORY and diverges.
rules.remediation: Move the entry from {path} to HISTORY.

rules.statement: No corpus counts in docs.
rules.reason: Counts rot on the next commit.

rules.statement: Every doc names one owner.
rules.reason: Shared ownership is no ownership.

rules.statement: Subjects match the conventional form.
rules.reason: Unparsed subjects break history checks.

rules.statement: No hook or check bypass.
rules.reason: Bypasses blind the guardrails.

rules.statement: No committed build output, caches or stray root files.
rules.reason: Committed output rots and bloats every clone.
rules.remediation: Delete {path} from the commit and ignore it.

rules.statement: File names follow the language convention.
rules.reason: Misnamed files break extraction and discovery.

rules.statement: Protected branches stay protected.
rules.reason: Unprotected branches land unreviewed work.

rules.statement: The repo has CI.
rules.reason: Without CI no gate runs on landing.

rules.statement: Required checks are configured.
rules.reason: Unrequired checks can be skipped silently.

rules.statement: CI actions are pinned to SHAs.
rules.reason: Floating actions change under review.

rules.statement: Hook and verify budgets hold.
rules.reason: Slow guards get bypassed.

rules.statement: Required agent assets exist.
rules.reason: Missing assets leave agents without guardrails.

rules.statement: The guardrail manifest matches the tree.
rules.reason: Drift between manifest and tree hides tampering.

rules.statement: Hooks are installed and active.
rules.reason: Inactive hooks never gate.

rules.statement: Pinned engine matches the installed one.
rules.reason: Version skew runs a different rule set than reviewed.

rules.statement: Waivers are valid and unexpired.
rules.reason: Expired waivers silently re-allow violations.
rules.remediation: Renew or remove the waiver for {detail} in {path}.

rules.statement: Custom packs pass self-test at L4.
rules.reason: Untested custom packs enforce unknown rules.
rules.remediation: Fix the self-test failure for {detail}, then re-accept.
